comparison.objective: Select required parts from a moving conveyor and assemble the pictured model while rejecting look-alikes.
comparison.physical_skill: Dynamic visual selection, interception, temporary parking, part transport, and model assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Required parts must form the model on two marks while extras leave and no part is held back long enough to jam the belt. The record supplies no standalone setup or scoring fields, though its body contains qualitative and partial numeric criteria.
comparison.reason: The objective and tested ability are clearly unrelated to connector depinning; missing standalone rubric fields do not create a plausible duplicate.
